title: SlimHUD
description: This resource pack changes the HUD of the game like hotbar, hearts, armor bar, hunger bar, XP bar and other things to a minimalistic feel.
body: This resource pack changes your entire HUD. From hearts being minimal to the locator bar too. It is currently kinda buggy with the panorama in the title menu, but still works ingame. I recommend this pack if you are a minimal person and don't want distractions while playing the game.
